faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind

items.q: How long does it take to build my website?
items.a: Depending on your package and how ready your content is, your site usually goes live within 7-14 days.

items.q: Will my site look good on mobile?
items.a: Yes. In every package, your site is designed to look great on phones, tablets and desktops.

items.q: What if I don’t like the design?
items.a: We never move to development without your approval of the design, and we revise it based on your feedback.

items.q: Will I show up on Google?
items.a: Every package includes basic SEO setup. Professional and higher packages also include advanced SEO and Google Analytics.

items.q: Do you offer support after launch?
items.a: Yes. Depending on your package, we provide 1 to 12 months of support for any technical issues.

items.q: I’m not sure which package is right for me.
items.a: No problem. In a free discovery call we listen to your needs and pick the best package together.
